title: EnableFastTravel - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to fast travel on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableFastTravel(abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables fast travel. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable fast travel myLayer.EnableFastTravel()
; Disable fast travel InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.EnableFastTravel(false) See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - FastTravel - Game - IsFastTravelEnabled - InputEnableLayer
